rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §70's gate logs are written "under the run directory", a durable path, and no gate or control is sent to a node-local temp or scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §70's new test path `tests/test_unwatch_reads_the_reconciled_seat.py` is mechanism-named, and the section's prose carries no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags into code.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause matches the cited reading (the refusal at recovery_watch.py:404-409 compares the raw registration's `project` against the asked-for project), the mechanism (decide from the reconciled reading `watch_state` builds via `_fresh_watch_holder`, watch_unit.py:203-210) is capable of producing the done-when including the holder's pid, and the path is real: while a producer lives it holds the seat lock for the producer's whole life, so `unwatch` takes the BlockingIOError branch and reads the mid-write record, and `lease.claim()` at runs.py:2879 precedes the registration write at runs.py:2941, so `_fresh_watch_holder` sees a live local holder.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §70 closes one result, that `unwatch` reads the reconciled seat, and the reconcile-and-still-refuse cases are part of that one verdict rather than a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the document unit's `plan-section-declarations` declares s7, s8, s10 and s11 `implementable`, but the followups block (49 entries, closing at the open f-tmstwiw-071 which carries §70) contains no followup naming §7, §8, §10 or §11, so the plan's executable remainder and its dispatch carriers disagree.
